source.quote: Hegel's own page for the D50, read 2026-11-24. « Digital inputs »: « 1 x AES/EBU S/PDIF, 24/192, DSD64(DoP), MQA 8x, 1 x Coaxial (BNC) S/PDIF, 24/192, DSD64(DoP), MQA 8x, 1 x Coaxial (RCA) S/PDIF, 24/192, DSD64(DoP), MQA 8x, 2 x Optical S/PDIF, 24/96, MQA 8x, 1 x USB 32/384, DSD256(DoP), MQA 8x ». The prose says only « At its core lies the latest model DAC chip ». No DAC chip is named anywhere on the page, and no digital filter, oversampling or NOS row exists.

facts.chip: Not named. The page says « At its core lies the latest model DAC chip » and nothing more - a sentence that will be false before the product is discontinued.

_hegel_ecrit_DoP_partout_et_native_nulle: Every DSD figure on every Hegel page carries « (DoP) »: « DSD64(DoP) » on the S/PDIF inputs, « DSD256(DoP) » on USB. Not one page says native. So dop is true and native_dsd is ABSENT - not false, because the maker never addresses it. Among 110 records this is the only brand that states the transport on every DSD figure it publishes and never once states the alternative.
_mqa_8x_sur_chaque_entree_et_aucun_champ: « MQA 8x » appears beside the rate on every input of every Hegel that has figures. Fifth brand in the harvest to publish MQA support - after Berkeley, CH Precision, MSB and Wadax - and still no field: MQA's bearing on a conversion engine is not established, and a field nobody can act on is worse than a gap.
_loptique_est_la_seule_entree_sans_dsd: Four of five inputs carry « DSD64(DoP) » or better; the two optical inputs carry « 24/96, MQA 8x » and no DSD at all. inputs.dsd_max is left absent there rather than filled: the maker listed DSD on the inputs that have it and omitted it where there is none, which is a pattern rather than an oversight, but an omission is still not a statement. Compare the Schiit Yggdrasil, where the maker says outright that no input takes DSD and the enum has no word for it.
_bnc_et_rca_sont_deux_entrees_et_une_seu: « 1 x Coaxial (BNC) » and « 1 x Coaxial (RCA) », rated identically, plus « 2 x Optical ». Five sockets, three keys, no figure lost because the ceilings agree within each type. Same shape as Naim's BNC against RCA, where the figures did NOT agree and something was lost.
